widgets_values:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the fairy girl in <Picture 1>: a small anime fairy with long wavy pink twin-tails, gold star hair ornaments and green leaf clips, large sparkling pink eyes, translucent pale-green butterfly wings, a white and green leaf-petal dress with gold lacing, kneeling on a mossy forest path, a wooden paintbrush in her right hand and a round wooden palette loaded with rainbow paint in her left.
<Subject 2> is the environment: a sunlit enchanted forest clearing with tall mossy trees, a small waterfall and stream on the right, pink lilies in the foreground, a wooden signboard hanging on the left, a lantern and jars of brushes on a tree-stump table, and a large canvas standing on a wooden easel decorated with a gold star and ivy on the right side of the frame.

summary:
[motion-context chain, segment 2 of 3] She adds a boat, a figure and stars to the painting.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in every shot): fully_preserved — pink twin-tail shape, gold star ornaments, green leaf clips, wing shape and leaf-petal dress stay identical throughout.
<Subject 2>: fully_preserved — the easel stays on the right, the stump table on the left, the waterfall behind.
Motion: mandatory — she must keep painting and moving; she must never freeze in the opening pose.
Speech continuity: mandatory — she speaks continuously and never repeats a line she has already spoken.

detailed_description:
Bright hand-painted anime style, soft golden sunbeams through leaves, floating sparkles, saturated storybook colours, slow gentle camera drift, her face and mouth clearly readable in every shot.
[Shot 1] She lifts the brush clear of the canvas and turns it slowly between her fingers, checking the bristles against the sunlight while the forest hums around her, saying nothing yet.
[Shot 2] At 00:01.500, she loads red paint and sets a tiny boat far out on the horizon line, <d>[Chinese]第四笔，远远的地方出现一艘红色的船</d>.
[Shot 3] At 00:04.216, she pulls her hand back and squints one eye to judge the distance, <d>[Chinese]正在靠过来</d>.
[Shot 4] At 00:06.932, she holds her breath and taps a small figure with a hat onto the bow, <d>[Chinese]第五笔，船头站着一个戴着帽子的人</d>.
[Shot 5] At 00:09.647, she lifts her own free hand and waves back at the little painted figure, <d>[Chinese]在对我挥手</d>.
[Shot 6] At 00:12.364, she jabs bright dots across the upper canvas one after another, <d>[Chinese]第六笔，天空点上七颗亮亮的星星</d>.

overall_soundscape:
Quiet forest ambience with birdsong and running water, the soft scrape and tap of a brush on canvas. Her voice is close, clear and unhurried.

non_diegetic_music:
A gentle low music-box melody kept quiet under the voice, never louder than her speech.

[Shot 6] At 00:12.364, she sits back, lowers the brush and turns her whole upper body to face the camera, beaming, <d>[Chinese]画完了，这样今天的画就完成了</d>.

detailed_description:
Bright hand-painted anime style, soft golden sunbeams through leaves, floating sparkles, saturated storybook colours, slow gentle camera drift, her face and mouth clearly readable in every shot.
[Shot 1] She dips the brush and drags a wide blue band across the lower canvas, <d>[Chinese]第一笔，我先画一片很蓝很蓝的海</d>.
[Shot 2] At 00:02.513, she rocks back on her heels and tips her head to study the far edge of the colour, <d>[Chinese]蓝到看不见边</d>.
[Shot 3] At 00:05.026, she turns the brush flat and dabs a soft white cloud into the upper area, <d>[Chinese]第二笔，海的上面加一朵白色的云朵</d>.
[Shot 4] At 00:07.539, she traces a slow arc through the air with the brush tip to show it drifting, <d>[Chinese]慢慢地飘过去</d>.
[Shot 5] At 00:10.053, she swaps to a fine brush and flicks a small gold fish into the blue, <d>[Chinese]第三笔，水里游来一只金色的小鱼</d>.
[Shot 6] At 00:12.566, she snaps her wrist twice to whip in the tail, grinning, <d>[Chinese]尾巴一直摇</d>.
